metric_conventions.edge_median: arithmetic mean of the third and fourth of six sorted edge lengths
metric_conventions.mean_ratio: 12*(3*V)^(2/3)/sum(six squared edges) for positive orientation; otherwise zero
metric_conventions.minimum_dihedral_deg: minimum of six interior dihedral angles, in degrees; null for degeneracy
metric_conventions.orientation: sign of dot(cross(p1-p0,p2-p0),p3-p0); zero is degenerate
metric_conventions.range_limited: a nonzero measurement could not be represented as a finite nonzero binary64 value
metric_conventions.scaled_jacobian: sqrt(2)*signed determinant / maximum of four incident edge-length products
metric_conventions.scope: Tet4 shape only; no CAD, connectivity, overlap, or simulation certificate
metric_conventions.signed_volume: signed determinant / 6, in input length units cubed
metric_conventions.volume_equivalent_edge: edge of a regular tetrahedron of equal absolute volume

interpretation: All eight owned requests completed Native gates and independent orientation, ownership, metric, tag and archive-identity screens. This is not installed-wheel, full corpus, cross-platform or simulation qualification.
The original 90-second thin 0.10 refusal is retained. Current success took 100.34 seconds under a longer explicit deadline; no gain in the old 90-second coverage score is established.
Thin 0.25 is byte-identical and still strongly anisotropic. Thin 0.10 retains an extremely near-flat cell, despite completed geometry checks.
Sphere size responsiveness persists in the combined build, but the coarse minimum remains worse than the former fan and the fronts still report stalled.
Plate-hole and cylinder results preserve Native validity with small count/distribution changes; a finer plate has a lower worst-cell quality than its coarser counterpart.

The rotated torus switched from the analytical torus route with 226,800 Tet4 cells to native_spatial_sizing with 8,511 Tet4 cells. The global request matches, but achieved size, CAD error and quality tails differ substantially. This is not a comparable-fidelity speed result.
The figure sphere panels remain source-shell-v1 artifacts, with a different extension and archive hashes; they are not substitutes for these combined-build records.
